bio.heading: Who we are
bio.text: 2-Limited is an acoustic rock duo formed in France, blending raw guitar energy with heartfelt vocals. Two musicians, one vision: powerful, stripped-down rock.

bio.heading: Our sound
bio.text: We strip rock back to its essence — two guitars, two voices, and nothing to hide behind. Our music is direct, emotional, and built to last.

members.name: Cam
members.bio: Piano at 6, drums at 10, guitar at 14 — the Black Album, Iron Maiden's Seventh Son of a Seventh Son and Queen I & II sealed the deal. Cam formed his first band, Offensive, in high school at 18, and hasn't stopped since: bass, vocals, and self-produced records along the way. In 2-LIMITED he holds down the low end, drives the beat on cajon, hi-hat and snare played by foot, and sings — bringing years of experience, his own musical universe, a few original compositions, and admittedly terrible jokes. Influences: Queen, Metallica, Iron Maiden, Angra, Supertramp, Nightwish, and many more.
